summary: End-to-end testing of Agent Portal (auth + dashboard + filters + RFP). Backend: 18/18 pytest tests PASS covering registration (with duplicate 400), login (401 for wrong pwd/unknown email), /me auth guard + no password_hash/_id leak, 3 destinations (Egypt/Sri Lanka/Vietnam × 4 pkgs each), package filtering by destination/type/combined, RFP auth requirement, RFP submission (full + minimal payload). Frontend: 14/14 UI flows PASS — unauth /agent/dashboard redirects to /agent/login, login succeeds with test@agency.com, welcome heading + agent.name + agency shown, 3 destination cards visible, 12 packages default, Egypt filter shows 4 pkgs, deselect returns to 12, FIT=6, Group=6, All=12, RFP prefill respects selected destination (Vietnam), RFP submit success modal, logout clears localStorage and redirects to /agent/login. Registration flow via UI also verified (new agent → dashboard).

issues: Third-party geo call to https://ipapi.co/json/ fires on every load and is blocked by CORS — pollutes console with errors (non-blocking, pre-existing from iteration_13).

action_items: No blocking issues — all requested features work end-to-end.
Optional: Silence or swap out the ipapi.co/json/ geo detection call to reduce console noise.
critical_code_review_comments: agent_routes.py: JWT_SECRET falls back to empty string via os.environ.get('JWT_SECRET', '') — in production this would silently break signature verification. Consider raising on missing secret at startup.

agent_routes.py get_agent_packages: type-param normalisation branch is odd — `type.upper() if type.upper() == 'FIT' else type.capitalize()` works but is a smell. Simpler: `{'fit':'FIT','group':'Group'}[type.lower()]`.

AgentDashboard.js: `axios.get(/api/agent/me)` catch clears localStorage on ANY error (including transient network hiccups) — could unexpectedly log a user out. Suggest checking err.response?.status === 401 only.

AgentDashboard.js: `border-[#0D1B2A]/06` uses an invalid Tailwind opacity value (06 → arbitrary, not a defined class). Renders as a border-transparent visually. Should be `/5` or `/10`. Non-blocking cosmetic.
RFPModal: no client-side validation of pax_count > 0 — HTML `min=1` present but negative values via keyboard are still submittable in some browsers.
agent_seed.py: 12 seed packages inserted every startup — verify seed is idempotent (server.py should be checking collection count before insert, not re-covered in this test).
test_credentials: Agent: test@agency.com / test1234 (pre-existing, worked). Admin: admin@hidmc.com / HiDMC@2026 (not exercised — agent portal only).
seed_data_creation: Created a fresh agent via /api/agent/register during each pytest run (TEST_agent_<uuid>@example.com) and one UI-registered agent (ui_reg_<uuid>@example.com). RFPs submitted with message 'TEST_RFP - please ignore' / 'UI test — please ignore'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_agent_portal.py covers all agent endpoints. Frontend playwright script validated all 8 flows from review_request. Agent portal is a separate route tree (/agent/*) using its own JWT (agent_token/agent_info in localStorage) and its own MongoDB collections (agents, agent_packages, rfp_requests). Main destinations collection (29 destinations) is unrelated to the agent portal's 3-destination scope.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 8 review-request scenarios pass on first execution.
